name: The Hall of Unsung Kings
intro: The last chord fades and the Elemental Nexus fades with it. You stand in a hall built to hold a song — and the song is gone. Only the silence it left behind remains, and the silence is listening.

rooms.name: The Hall of Unsung Kings - The Gallery of Faces
rooms.description: Portraits of kings line the walls, every one with its mouth painted out. North, a door carved with musical notes stands shut.

rooms.name: The Hall of Unsung Kings - The Silent Stair
rooms.description: A great stair climbs between pillars carved like organ pipes. Your footsteps make no sound on it at all. North, the throne room doors are sealed.

rooms.name: The Hall of Unsung Kings - The Mute Throne
rooms.description: A throne of silent bells under a crown of stopped clocks. The king on it has been waiting a thousand years for someone to remember the words.

waves.text: Hollow courtiers step down out of the portraits!
The courtiers come down the silent stair toward you!
Silent echoes pour from the organ-pipe pillars!

gates.text: The carved door hums a single note and swings open.
The throne room doors open on silence.

boss.text: The Mute King rises from his throne of silent bells. He opens his mouth to speak, and nothing comes out — nothing at all. Then he draws his sword.
